other.content:
Signed, dated, and titled, verso, on on cardboard backing: Georgia O'Keeffe / Abiquiu, N. M. / Title: Blue B-1960 1959 [two dates written in different ink] / Year: 1960 1959 [two dates written in different ink] / Medium: Oil / Size: 30 x 36 / Base: / Photograph: 
(Source: MAM, 2025)

cr_data.provenance:
[1] By April 11, 1961, (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA); [2] April 20, 1961, purchased by Mrs. Harry Lynde (Margaret, or Peg, Blakney Sullivan) Bradley [1894–1978] (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); [3] December 1973, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1] Downtown Gallery, Georgia O'Keefe: Recent Paintings & Drawings (New York: The Downtown Gallery, 1961), cat. 5. 
[2] Invoice addressed to Mrs. Harry Lynde Bradley in MAM object file, marked paid by “Mrs. B.” on June 26, 1961. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 2 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 849, cat. 1557. 
[3] Documentation from The Bradley Family Foundation in MAM object file 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Stretcher inscription may indicate preparatory work. Titled *Blue B* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
